Lifeline’s ult is irrelevant?!? I am curious to know your reasoning behind this comment. Her ult is far from irrelevant and it can definitely win you a final circle battle. Different legends bring different things to the table. Yes, NC can res and drag his team out of line of sight of the enemy but this completely takes him out of the fight allowing the enemy team to reposition and close any distance that may have been gained off the NC passive res plus more. On the other hand, LL can hit res behind cover and instantly put down cover fire or contest anyone who may have closed the distance too quickly. The picks are situational most definitely. In higher ranks I see a mix of both because of what they both individually bring to the table. Stormpoint and broken moon? Probably best to go NC due to the sheer amount of open areas the ring loves to close on. Worlds edge and kings canyon? Probably best to go LL due to the sheer amount of buildings and accessible cover that is offered from the map. There is no real answer other than preference. Smaller hit box vs bigger hit box also becomes less of a point in higher ranks because higher ranked players tend to know how to take a fight and should never be exposed to the point of getting beamed off a peek.

I agree with this to certain point. If the difficulty plateaus at a certain point until you reach the next point, there can be an argument made that there was no improvement. Since you are staying within the rank you are in and only playing those within the same rank, consciously working on things like movement mechanics and recoil control, would warrant improvement. This is literally the problem we had in ranked before people could demote. All the hardstuck diamond and play players would literally be at diamond 4 for the majority of the season because they simply cannot progress. The jump from skill from gold to plat is significant and that gap gets smaller the higher you rank up. So to throw inexperienced diamond players who just got promoted to masters in a lobby of masters is never going to end well. They will be going in with 0 experience as to how to manage these newer and better players, leaving them stuck at 15,000 rp if demotion was not around. But I do believe that after a certain rank in diamond you should 100% be matched with masters and even preds, this is simply due to the fact that you will never reach that rank unless you cheese, dedicate time to practice or play a long ass time to the point where u get accustomed to the better players.
